cases.name: Nicole “Nikki” D. Meyer VanderHeyden
cases.narrative: On 5/21/2016, her body, naked apart from a pink wristband from her night out and a sock was found in a field three miles from her home. The rest of her clothes were found dumped off a local highway. She'd been thrown down an embankment after being murdered elsewhere. Nicole was so badly beaten that she had to be identified from dental records. She had suffered 241 injuries and had been strangled, possibly with an electrical cord that was found with blood on it. With bruises to her hands and broken fingernails, it was clear Nicole had fought hard before being overpowered. Evidence showed she’d had sex before being killed, but it was difficult to determine whether it had been consensual. Blood splatters on her body were consistent with Nicole having been stomped on as she lay on the ground. It was a brutal, violent murder. Her blood was then found on the ground near her home. She had been murdered in her own neighborhood.
